activityDescription: Description: A casual campus event where individuals or groups perform live music. Participants may perform with a band, instrumental accompaniment, karaoke/backing tracks, or solo. The atmosphere is informal and welcoming to performers of all experience levels. Activities: Live musical performances in front of an audience. Food is provided before the event begins, and performers sign up in a queue to take turns on stage. Eligibility: Open to all students regardless of faculty or club membership. Location: Schulich Social Stairs, Engineering Building, University of Calgary Schedule: Sign-up and food begin at 5:30 PM Performances begin at 6:00 PM Purpose: To provide an inclusive space for students to share musical talent and build community through live performance.
activityType: Category A: Student Life Events and Mental Well-Being
